skipped.reason: Not reproduced: PDF p. 26, Table 18, conditionLoExposure_Disclosed prints coefficient 0.011, SE 0.112, t = 0.095; the full Table 18 model has 3,271 output observations. The supplied massivetexts/llm_aut_study deposit is the historical Organisciak classifier-evaluation dataset cited in PDF p. 13, Appendix A.1, footnotes 6-7, not this randomized experiment. All 55 CSV members were read. The cited gt_main2/gpt-ft-davinci-1.csv has 3,030 responses from 1,384 historical participants, 21 prompts and 9 source studies; the experiment instead reports 844 people and 3,414 retained responses (PDF p. 7, Table 2). No CSV has the experimental arm assignments, response-chain IDs, or participant condition order. The experiment's exclusions (two incorrectly shown responses and 36 profane responses removed from 3,452, PDF pp. 17-18, SI 3) cannot be applied to this historical corpus. The experimental originality scores, participant IDs, covariates and nested/crossed grouping variables needed for the printed mixed model are unavailable. The paper prints no arm means as an alternative reproduction target. The historical counts are a dataset-identity diagnostic, not recomputed experimental counts. No paired all-round or HC2 first_round result is computed: neither complete condition pairs nor each person's first condition can be identified. The historical response_num field is not experimental condition_order.

Not reproduced: PDF p. 22, Table 12, row 0 prints a difference of 1.210000 in median pairwise cosine distance multiplied by 100. The supplied massivetexts/llm_aut_study deposit is the historical Organisciak classifier-evaluation dataset cited in PDF p. 13, Appendix A.1, footnotes 6-7, not this randomized experiment. All 55 CSV members were read. The cited gt_main2/gpt-ft-davinci-1.csv has 3,030 responses from 1,384 historical participants, 21 prompts and 9 source studies; the experiment instead reports 844 people and 3,414 retained responses (PDF p. 7, Table 2). No CSV has the experimental arm assignments, response-chain IDs, or participant condition order. The experimental response texts with their condition/item/chain positions and original SBERT embeddings are absent. The paper does not name the exact SBERT checkpoint. Scalar predictions from the historical scoring-model evaluations cannot replace those embeddings. The same texts and embedding procedure required by rule 5 cannot be recovered; this set-level outcome has no participant-level value. SI 8.1 (PDF p. 21) requires retained experimental responses after chain trial six, 50 sampled ideas per condition/item in each of 50 Monte Carlo runs, and 10,000 paired sign permutations with Holm adjustment. The necessary input sets and original sampling information are unavailable. No arm levels, contrast, participant SD or SE is computed.
